Select distinct rows for IC50 activities against target CHEMBL5071. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures (inner join). Filter by target CHEMBL5071, standard_type IC50, and presence of canonical_smiles. Prefer pubmed_id over doi for pubmed_id_or_doi. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
